purpose: Exercise backup/restore, isolated production deployment and full browser acceptance without touching production data.

findings.message: Shipped backup.sh and restore.sh completed against an isolated restore database.
Docker Compose built and started an isolated production API/web/worker/PostgreSQL stack; health and seed completed.
24 required Chromium journeys; real API, no network mocks. See retained artifacts for failures.
